notes: MAIN HARMONY RISK: in the resolver, each profession is three separate families (1f9d1_200d_X person, 1f468_200d_X man, 1f469_200d_X woman; base_key does not merge them). So under 7.1, all 16 professions (health worker, student, teacher, judge, farmer, cook, mechanic, factory worker, office worker, scientist, technologist, singer, artist, pilot, astronaut, firefighter) get a man/woman pair in 7.1 and a person in android-12. The designs differ a lot, not just the face: farmer (7.1 big yellow hat, green shirt, wheat vs 12 straw hat, overalls, pitchfork), cook (grey vs white toque), mechanic (orange overalls vs blue cap), judge (7.1 sits in a dark chair vs 12 has a gavel), factory worker (dark vs grey mask), plus eyebrows and hair shading. At 20px the person form and the man/woman forms look like different emoji. Gboard offers the gender-neutral form first, so the android-12 style is what most text will show. Simulated: 7.1 takes 306 of 492 keys, android-12 168, latest 18 (person with crown 1fac5, pregnant man and person). Already in android-12 by family rule: tuxedo (1f935 family) and veil (1f470 family), because 7.1 lacks their E13 gender variants, plus ninja, headscarf, breast-feeding and the feeding-baby trio. The police, detective, guard, construction and turban families are fully 7.1 and consistent. Prince and princess in 7.1 are head-only (no bust), while 1fac5 person with crown (latest) is also a head, so they sit fine. 7.1 bases for police, detective, guard, construction and turban are the man design. If the owner prioritises trio harmony over the blob-era look, set the subgroup to android-12 (score close behind) and drop the overrides. I kept 7.1 for consistency with person-gesture and person-activity/sport, which are likely 7.1 too. No bordered art remains after fallback, because android-11 people are borderless. ANDROID-16 PASS: `recommended` follows the owner decision already in selection.toml (android-12, see REVIEW), now pinned as [android-12, android-16] so that keys android-12 lacks (pregnant man 1fac3, pregnant person 1fac4, person with crown 1fac5) come from android-16 even if the global fallback stays [android-12, latest]; android-12 wins for everything it has. The ranked scores (7.1 at 7) are the standalone per-emoji judgement and were not changed. The stale 7.1-era overrides (1f468_200d_1f680 and 1f469_200d_1f680 → android-12) were removed as redundant, because the subgroup is android-12 based; the old 1f930 → android-12 override is replaced by 1f930 → android-16. If the owner ever returns to android-7.1, re-add the two astronaut overrides to android-12 (7.1 man/woman astronaut have a dark-tinted visor face) and keep 1f930 → android-16; do NOT use android-16 for astronauts (small face behind a tinted golden visor, same as latest). WHERE ANDROID-16 AND LATEST DIFFER in this subgroup: only the pregnant trio (1f930, 1fac3, 1fac4); android-16 is the flatter, less glossy one (plain side-view, no hand on belly, no gradient), latest is shaded. Everywhere else the tiles are identical. Compared with android-12 the android-16 redraws (judge, cook, technologist, singer, artist, astronaut, guard, prince/princess, breast-feeding, feeding baby) are more detailed and not recommended for 20px consistency; no `=11`-marked (bordered android-11) tile is recommended, the unchanged professions are borderless android-12 art. Emoji 18 additions in person-role (if any) have no android-16 art and fall through the chain to latest. android-16 before latest: yes (it only changes 1fac3/1fac4, to the flatter version that matches the 1f930 override).
